name: shop-app
title: Shop app screen
description: A generic shopping app on a phone screen, 720x1560 for 9 seconds: the search bar types a query with a blinking caret, four product cards rise in one after another, the first is tapped, its page slides in with name, price, rating and a button, the button is pressed and a toast with a check mark confirms it. Lines: the query, the product's name, its price, the button and the toast; the defaults are placeholders ("Product name", "$49"), so set them for the user's product. Put it below the phone device frame; it renders in a headless browser.

name: route-map-3d
title: 3D route map
description: A dark city seen from above at a tilt, 1080x1920 for 7 seconds, rendered with Three.js: blocks of lit buildings from a seed, a glowing route drawn on along the streets with a dot riding its head, and a map pin that drops in at its end, while the camera tilts down, turns and pushes in. route lists street crossings (x, y) from the middle of the grid; turns follow the streets. Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

params.name: seed
params.description: Picks the buildings: the same seed gives the same city.

params.name: blocks
params.description: City blocks along each side of the grid.

params.name: route
params.description: Street crossings the route passes, as [x, y] pairs counted in blocks from the middle; between two crossings it runs along x, then y.

params.name: ground_color
params.description: The ground between the blocks.

params.name: block_color
params.description: The buildings.

params.name: street_color
params.description: The faint lines along the streets.

params.name: window_color
params.description: The lit windows.

params.name: route_color
params.description: The route's glow.

params.name: dot_color
params.description: The dot at the route's head.

params.name: pin_color
params.description: The pin at the route's end.

params.name: max_height
params.description: The tallest buildings, in block widths; buildings along the route stay low.

params.name: draw_start
params.description: When the route starts drawing, in seconds.

params.name: draw_duration
params.description: How long the route takes to draw, in seconds.

params.name: pin_delay
params.description: Seconds between the route's arrival and the pin's drop.

params.name: tilt_to

name: parcel-drop-3d
title: 3D parcel drop
description: A cardboard parcel with a logo printed on its front drops onto a floor, 1080x1920 for 4 seconds, rendered with Three.js: it falls with a little spin, squashes on impact, bounces and settles, with a soft contact shadow, a dust ring, a burst of sparks and a small camera shake. logo takes an image or SVG asset (FossCut's own mark when empty). Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

params.description: An image or SVG asset printed on the box's front; FossCut's own mark when empty.

params.name: floor_color

params.name: box_height

params.name: box_depth

params.name: shake

name: phone-3d
title: 3D phone with a live screen
description: A modern generic phone in 3D with rounded corners, a metal frame and a rim glow, 1080x1920 for 6 seconds, rendered with Three.js: it rises into view, turns towards the camera and the camera pushes in. Its screen shows a live web composition (the shop-app screen by default, playing on its own clock from screen_start), or an image or video asset. Bloom, depth of field and motion blur on the phone; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

title: 3D extruded logo
description: A logo extruded into a solid with bevelled edges, 1080x1920 for 4 seconds, rendered with Three.js: it swings in from the side, settles with a little overshoot, and a band of light sweeps across its face before it turns slowly. logo takes an SVG asset with filled shapes (FossCut's own mark when empty). Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

name: product-podium-3d
title: 3D product on a podium
description: A product turning on a lit podium, 1080x1920 for 6 seconds, rendered with Three.js: the product rises onto the podium, the turntable spins, a ring of light glows round the podium's edge, the floor and podium top reflect it, and the camera pushes in. product takes an image asset (shown as a card) or a glTF model asset; a FossCut-made bottle when empty. Bloom, depth of field and motion blur; transparent: true lays it over other clips. Needs the GPU renderer (macOS).

params.name: push

name: video-card
title: Video card
description: A generic video card, 1080x860 with a clear background: a 16:9 thumbnail with a play button, its length and a watched bar, the channel's avatar, the title and a line of views and age; it pops in, the views count up and the watched bar fills. Use it when the speaker mentions a video, a channel, an upload or a long-form piece. thumbnail takes a picture or a video (abstract art when empty). Above the speaker's head at scale 0.85, position [0, -0.29]; the top half of a split screen at scale 1, position [0, -0.25].

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: The thumbnail: a picture, or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: avatar
params.description: The channel's picture; its initials on a gradient when empty.

params.name: title
params.default: How I edit a week of videos in one afternoon
params.description: The video's title, up to two lines.

params.name: channel
params.description: The channel's name; empty hides it.

params.name: views
params.description: The views, whose number counts up ("1.2M views", "12,400 views"); empty hides it.

params.name: age
params.description: How old the video is; empty hides it.

params.name: length
params.description: The length badge on the thumbnail; empty hides it.

params.name: watched
params.description: How far the watched bar along the thumbnail's bottom fills; 0 hides it.

name: app-window
title: App window
description: A generic editing app window, 1080x780 with a clear background: a title bar with an export button, a media panel, a viewer showing a picture or video, and a timeline whose clips build in under a running playhead. Use it when the speaker talks about editing software, a desktop app or the old way of working (lay cross-out over it with the same placement to cross it out). Above the head at scale 0.9, position [0, -0.29]; the top half of a split screen at scale 1, position [0, -0.25].

params.name: media
params.description: What the viewer shows: a picture, or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: title
params.description: The project name in the title bar.

params.name: button
params.description: The button at the right of the title bar; empty hides it.

params.name: panel
params.description: The media panel's heading; empty hides it.

params.name: timeline
params.description: Show the timeline with its clips and playhead under the viewer.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window, 1080x700 with a clear background, dark by default: each step is typed behind a prompt, waits a moment and gets a green check mark, one after another. Use it for a sequence of steps, commands or an automated process ("it analyzes, cuts, captions and exports"). With the default four steps the last check lands at about 4.6 s; raise speed or hold for other counts. Above the head at scale 0.9, position [0, -0.29].

params.name: title
params.description: The title bar's text.

params.name: steps
params.description: The lines typed, one after another, up to six.

params.name: prompt
params.description: The prompt before every line.

params.name: done
params.description: The word beside each check mark; empty shows the mark alone.

params.name: typing
params.description: Characters typed per second.

name: review-frame
title: Review frame
description: A full-screen review app around a vertical video, 1080x1920: a bar with the file's name and a share button, version pills, the video in a rounded window, a scrubber with comment markers, a comment and Approve and Request changes buttons. Use it when the speaker talks about feedback, reviews, versions or sending a cut to a client. media shows a picture or video in the window; open: true leaves the window clear so the speaker's own clip shows through: put that clip under the overlay at scale 0.575, position [0, -0.05]. Place it full screen at scale 1.

params.name: media
params.description: What the video window shows when open is off: a picture, or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: open
params.description: Leave the video window clear so a clip below shows through it (a full-frame 9:16 clip at scale 0.575, position [0, -0.05] fills it).

params.name: file_name
params.description: The file's name in the top bar.

params.name: subtitle
params.description: The line under the file's name; empty hides it.

params.name: share
params.description: The top bar's button; empty hides it.

params.name: versions
params.description: The version pills, up to six.

params.name: current
params.description: The version shown as current, counted from 1; 0 picks the last.

params.name: notes
params.description: The pill at the end of the versions row; empty hides it.

params.name: commenter
params.description: Who wrote the comment; their initials mark the scrubber.

params.description: The time the comment points at; empty hides it.

params.default: Love the pacing. Can we trim the intro a little?

params.name: changes

name: social-post
title: Social post
description: A generic social media post, 1080x1240 with a clear background: an avatar with a name, handle and time, the post's text, a picture, and like, comment and share counts; the heart fills with a burst while the counts go up. Use it for a post, a viral moment, engagement or audience reactions. No platform's look or marks. Above the head at scale 0.58, position [0, -0.29]; the top half of a split screen at scale 0.77, position [0, -0.25].

params.description: The poster's picture; their initials on a gradient when empty.

params.name: time

name: quote-panel

description: A quote panel, 1080x760 with a clear background: a large quotation mark, the quote revealed word by word with one phrase marked in the accent colour, and its author with an avatar and role. name: before-after

description: A before and after card, 1080x760 with a clear background: two pictures or videos in one frame split by a handle that sweeps across to reveal the after side and springs back to the split, each side labelled. Use it for a transformation, an improvement, raw against edited, or old against new. With empty slots both sides show the same art, dull and soft before, vivid after. name: cross-out
title: Cross out
description: Red X marks (or strike lines) drawn on stroke by stroke with a punch, 1080x780 with a clear background, placed by fractions of the canvas. Use it to reject something on screen: lay it over another overlay with the same placement (set width and height to that overlay's canvas when it differs), or over the video itself to cross out an object. marks lists the marks' centres from the canvas's middle.

params.name: style
params.description: An X, or a strike line across.

params.name: marks

params.description: Each mark's size: an X's width as a fraction of the canvas's shorter side, a strike's length as a fraction of its width.

params.name: color

description: A curved arrow, 800x800 with a clear background, that draws on towards the canvas's middle, where its tip lands, with an optional label at its tail, then nudges at its target. Use it to point at something in the picture or at another overlay: place the clip so the canvas's middle is on the target (position = the target's position), at scale 0.5 to 0.7.

params.name: label
params.description: The label at the arrow's tail; empty hides it.

params.description: Where the arrow comes from, towards the middle.

name: audio-chip

params.name: top_color

name: timeline-cut
title: Timeline cut
description: A timeline losing its dead parts, 1080x620 with a clear background: the cut parts are marked in red with scissors, shrink away while the kept clips close up, and the total length counts down from one time to another, ending in green with a done chip. Use it when the speaker talks about cutting silences, filler, retakes or making a video shorter. Above the head at scale 0.9, position [0, -0.29]; the top half of a split screen at scale 1, position [0, -0.25].

params.name: label
params.description: The label over the counter; empty hides it.

name: progress-card
title: Progress card
description: A progress card, 1080x460 with a clear background: a title and status line, a percentage counting up, a bar filling with a running sheen, and step chips that tick off one by one as the bar passes them, the current one spinning. Use it for work in progress, a pipeline, rendering or exporting, or how far along something is. Above the head at scale 0.9, position [0, -0.3].

params.name: title
params.description: The heading.

params.name: status
params.description: The line under the heading; empty hides it.

params.name: steps
params.description: The steps, in order, up to eight; each takes an equal share of the bar.

params.name: progress
params.description: Where the bar stops, from 0 to 1.

name: stat-counter
title: Stat counter
description: A big number, 900x560 with a clear background: it counts up to its value with a prefix and suffix in the accent colour, an accent line grows under it, a label explains it and a trend chip pops in. Use it for any figure the speaker says: results, growth, money, hours saved, percentages. Above the head at scale 0.75, position [0, -0.29].

params.name: value
params.description: The number counted up to.

params.name: from
params.description: The number counting starts from.

params.name: decimals
params.description: Decimal places shown.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Text before the number, such as "$" or "+".

params.name: suffix
params.description: Text after the number, such as "%", "K" or " hrs".

params.name: kicker
params.description: The small line above the number; empty hides it.

params.name: label
params.description: What the number means; empty hides it.

params.name: trend
params.description: The trend chip; empty hides it.

params.name: trend_up
params.description: A green chip with an up arrow; false makes it red with a down arrow.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: A bar chart card, 1080x820 with a clear background: a title and subtitle, up to twelve bars growing one after another with their values counting up, the highlighted bar in the accent colour with a badge. Use it to compare numbers: views per video, before and after figures, growth over time. Above the head at scale 0.88, position [0, -0.29]; the top half of a split screen at scale 1, position [0, -0.25].

params.name: title
params.description: The heading.

params.name: subtitle
params.description: The line under the heading; empty hides it.

params.name: labels
params.description: The bars' names, left to right.

params.name: values
params.description: The bars' values, left to right, up to twelve; the tallest fills the chart.

params.name: highlight
params.description: The bar in the accent colour, counted from 1; 0 picks the largest.

params.name: badge
params.description: The badge over the highlighted bar; empty hides it.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Text before each value, such as "$".

params.name: suffix
params.description: Text after each value, such as "K" or "%".

params.name: decimals
params.description: Decimal places of the values.

name: clock-card
title: Clock card
description: A clock card, 760x900 with a clear background: the hands sweep from one time to another while an accent arc fills the time that passed, the time counts under the clock with a label, and a chip says how long it was. Use it when the speaker talks about time spent, time saved, hours of work or a deadline. Above the head at scale 0.57, position [0, -0.29].

params.name: from
params.description: The time the hands start at, as hours and minutes on a 12 hour face.

params.name: to
params.description: The time they sweep to; earlier than from means past 12.

params.name: label
params.description: The label under the time; empty hides it.

params.name: spent
params.description: The chip saying how long it was; empty hides it.

name: lower-third-card
title: Lower third card
description: A lower third card, 1080x360 with a clear background: a thumbnail with a play button, a small tag, a title, a subtitle and a call-to-action button with a nudging arrow; it slides in from the left and leaves to the left. Use it to point to a longer video, a resource, a product or the speaker's name and role. Low on the screen at scale 0.92, position [0, 0.3], clear of captions at 60% of the height.

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: The thumbnail: a picture, or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: tag
params.description: The small tag over the title; empty hides it.

params.name: title
params.description: The title, on one line.

params.name: subtitle
params.default: The whole workflow, step by step
params.description: The line under the title; empty hides it.

params.name: cta
params.description: The button; empty hides it.

name: comment-cta
title: Comment call to action
description: A comment notification, 1080x380 with a clear background: it drops in from the top with an avatar, a name, a time and a message whose keyword sits in an accent pill that pops and pulses, and leaves upwards. Use it for the closing call to action ("comment EDIT and I'll send it to you"). message holds {keyword} where the pill goes. Above the head at scale 0.9, position [0, -0.3], or low at scale 0.9, position [0, 0.3].

params.name: avatar
params.description: The commenter's picture; their initials on a gradient when empty.

params.name: header
params.description: The notification's heading.

params.name: name
params.description: The commenter's name; empty hides it.

params.name: time
params.description: When it came; empty hides it.

params.name: message
params.default: Comment {keyword} and I'll send you the full workflow
params.description: The message; {keyword} marks where the keyword's pill goes (after the message when missing).

params.name: keyword
params.description: The word in the accent pill; empty shows the message alone.

name: grid-stage
title: Grid stage
description: A full-screen background, 1080x1920: a glowing perspective grid floor (and optionally a ceiling) running towards a lit horizon, with picture cards arcing over the speaker's head and swaying. Use it to swap the background behind a cut-out speaker (key.subject) for a stylised stage on an emphatic line. Put it under the speaker's clip at scale 1; head_y sets the height the cards arc around. Slots card_1 to card_6 take pictures or videos (abstract art when empty).

params.name: cards
params.description: How many cards arc round the head; 0 shows the stage alone.

params.name: card_1
params.description: Card 1 from the left: a picture or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: card_2
params.description: Card 2 from the left: a picture or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: card_3
params.description: Card 3 from the left: a picture or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: card_4
params.description: Card 4 from the left: a picture or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: card_5
params.description: Card 5 from the left: a picture or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: card_6
params.description: Card 6 from the left: a picture or a video that plays from the entrance; abstract art when empty.

params.name: background
params.description: The stage's base colour; light colours make a light stage.

params.name: glow
params.description: How strong the horizon's glow is; 0 turns it off.

params.name: ceiling
params.description: Add a grid ceiling, for a tunnel.

params.name: grid_speed
params.description: Grid squares per second the floor runs towards the viewer; 0 stands still.

params.name: sway
params.description: How far the cards sway round the head, in degrees.

params.name: head_y
params.description: The height of the speaker's head as a fraction of the canvas from the top; the cards arc over it.

params.name: radius
params.description: The arc's radius as a fraction of the canvas width.
